name: Dhoot Transmission Limited
summary: Dhoot Transmission Limited operates as a manufacturer of wiring harnesses, automotive switches, electronic sensors and controllers, connectors, terminals, automotive cables, power cords, and related components. The company provides wiring harnesses for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, commercial vehicles, off-road vehicles, farm equipment, earth movers, medical equipment, and domestic appliances. It manufactures electronic sensors and controllers, automotive switches, connection systems, connectors and terminals, automotive cables, and power cords.
